WITH department_counts AS (
    SELECT m2.department, COUNT(DISTINCT i.link_to_member) AS member_count
    FROM income AS i
    JOIN member AS m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
    JOIN major AS m2 ON m.link_to_major = m2.major_id
    GROUP BY m2.department
), shares AS (
    SELECT department, member_count,
           1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM department_counts
), scored AS (
    SELECT department, member_count, share,
           AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT SUM(member_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share)
FROM scored
WHERE share > average_share;
